title: VitePress front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown page in a VitePress site. It lists VitePress's own keys; add the keys your site reads, each with a description.

aside.description: false hides the outline beside the page; "left" moves it to the start side.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

dir.description: The page's text direction; VitePress sets the html element's dir from it.

editLink.description: The "Edit this page" link: false hides it, a string is its address, or an object has pattern and text.

features.description: The cards under the hero on a home page, each with icon, title, details, and an optional link.

footer.description: false hides the footer on this page.

head.description: Extra tags for this page's head, each as [tag, attributes, innerHTML].

hero.description: The hero block on a home page: name, text, tagline, image, and actions.

lang.description: The page's language, such as fa, when it differs from the site's.

lastUpdated.description: false hides the last-updated time on this page.

layout.description: The theme layout: doc for documentation, home for a landing page, or page for a bare page.

outline.description: The outline beside the page: false hides it, a number or [min, max] sets its heading levels, and "deep" shows h2 to h6.

pageClass.description: An extra CSS class on the page's wrapper element.

sidebar.description: false hides the sidebar on this page.

title.description: The page title, shown in the browser tab and search results.

titleTemplate.description: false leaves the site title off this page's tab title; a string is the pattern, with :title where the page title goes.
